limitations: AFT is a dated, community-curated snapshot, not a complete census.
AFT relationship documentation is evidence of a source assertion, not independent validation of every edge.
AFT relation 4 (collaboration), missing mentor ids, and institutional affiliations do not establish descent.
Publication author links may be automated; retain score_human and score_total, and do not assert every match is verified.
Seed choices define the result; this is not a global census of AI researchers.
Graduate (AFT relation 1) does not establish doctoral rather than masters level.
Missing edge years and current career status remain unknown.
Broad descendant closure can include researchers outside AI; discipline labels are not admission criteria.
CMU historical archive retained separately and not automatically identity-merged.
Paper titles are absent from the downloaded AFT authorPub export; they remain unknown.
Main coauthor edges require two human-validated AFT author links. Automated matches are separate candidates.
Paper counts use AFT pubid records, not independently deduplicated primary publication metadata.
不根据合著、同校或同实验室推断导师。
本人最新主页优先于导师或研究组过时的在读标签。
细分方向仅在相关来源给出研究陈述时添加；未知留空。
合著仅为本层的六篇示例文献，并非完整论文履历。
不含联系人邮箱、私人生活资料或照片。
rootSeeds 是有文献依据的范围选择，并非证明所有 AI 研究者同属单一谱系。
Supplemental branches follow documented bridges and the original AFT mentorship records. Their AI relevance is not automatically verified by reachability.

Foundational roots are documented scope choices across AI, statistics, linguistics, neuroscience and vision. They do not imply that all selected roots were at Dartmouth or that all reachable descendants are individually verified AI researchers.

Additional historical subfield roots are explicit scope decisions with institutional or first-person evidence; they are not claimed to share a documented path to Alan Turing or the Dartmouth workshop.

The old raw Fei Fang identity belongs to another doctoral context and is not merged. Thirteen reviewed people have curated IDs; exact-source publication scanning cannot supply AFT matches for these curated-only identities.
Only the explicit published IJCAI 2015 paper supports the three additional coauthor pairs. No mentor or co-advisor role is inferred from coauthorship or generic lab membership.
Four doctoral-student statuses are dated observations of personal/faculty pages. Seven doctoral alumni are supported by completed-degree evidence. Historical CV dates are preserved.

Explicit co-advisors without their own rooted incoming path remain in readable source evidence. They are not added as roots or admitted via their student. Weiran Shen is not included as a postdoc edge because the checked primary appointment source does not identify Fang as the mentor.
Fang and Parkes CVs disagree on the exact postdoc months. The shared 2016-2017 years are used and the month conflict is retained in the edge notes.
This is the first three-person reviewed batch from the university audit, not the complete top-100 audit. Faculty source discovery entries are not automatically admitted.
Collaborating with a postdoctoral researcher does not establish supervisory direction; no Gupta postdoc mentor edge was inferred from that wording.
Source discovery candidates do not automatically enter the graph. Only explicit primary mentorship claims with a directed incoming path from existing roots are admitted.
Thesis-committee members and coauthors are not inferred to be advisers. In particular, Aaron Roth is a committee member rather than a doctoral adviser in Hoda Heidari's CV.
Nicholas Boffi and additional documented co-advisers/postdoctoral hosts remain pending where no reviewed rooted mentor path has been established.

Aaron Roth's own Penn page confirms Avrim Blum as doctoral adviser. Neither identity currently has a reviewed rooted path; this authenticated upstream claim is retained for later review, without confusing Avrim with Manuel Blum.

The Ming Yin branch is connected to existing root Marvin Minsky through William A. Martin's PhD and Szolovits's explicit first-person research-mentor account. Martin is not mislabeled as Szolovits's doctoral adviser.
Ming Yin is Harvard PhD2017 and Purdue faculty. The raw NC State Ming Yin identity AFT438666 is a different researcher and is excluded.

Nine explicitly documented PhD advisees are included. Six completed degrees are corroborated by Purdue's official annual list. Three in-progress statuses are dated March2026 observations, not claims of present-day enrollment.

Frederick B. Thompson, Chao-Hsien Chu and Rajiv Khanna are documented upstream or co-adviser endpoints in the research evidence but lack independently established rooted paths; no reverse traversal or new root admits them.
No postdoctoral supervisor is inferred from Ming Yin's MSR appointment, internship collaboration, paper authorship or committee membership.

Seven directly inspected primary papers add an observed lower-bound coauthorship sample among Ming Yin, her established adviser and nine established doctoral advisees. No person is admitted solely through authorship; unmatched author names are not turned into nodes.
Only explicit mentoring language enters relations. Mere lab membership, work-with text, committee membership and coauthorship do not create adviser edges.

Four raw identities (Kenji Sagae, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, William J Fefferman, Kyunghyun Cho) are independently corroborated by primary biographical details and existing adviser records; other additions use curated IDs with no raw merge.
Documented extra adviser claims without an admitted incoming path remain in the evidence record; ancestors are not admitted through a child.
Sixteen primary homepage snapshots reused and one linked academic CV downloaded, all with raw-byte SHA verification; no private discovery metadata enters the catalog.
The complete762-packet slice has manual context triage; only individually recorded full-source reviews count as complete reading. Context extraction is not a complete faculty or department audit.
Only explicitly supported relations whose mentor is independently reachable are imported. Unrooted co-advisers remain followups and cannot be admitted through their students.
Existing AFT IDs are reused only after manual identity review. New curated people receive no inferred AFT authorship matches.

Full-name and alias matching is discovery only: Columbia Xi Chen is not NYU linguistics Xi Chen, EPFL Robert West is not Iowa State psychologist Robert West, and Berkeley quantum-computing John Wright is not Columbia robotics John Wright.
The 380-packet excerpt pass is not 380 completed faculty audits. Full personal, outgoing, identity and fallback completeness remain separately recorded.
Anupam Datta as Blocki's other PhD adviser and Erik Sudderth as Hughes's PhD adviser remain recorded in the adjudication ledger; no unrooted upstream person is admitted by reversing an edge.
Postdoctoral working-with/group-membership phrases for other subjects remain context and were not converted into mentorship.

Three mentor identity corroborations were read from primary public web sources and are explicitly not claimed as locally archived; all six added relationship claims have hash-verified local primary archives.
Only documented directed mentorship from existing admitted people is imported. No new roots or inferred coauthor-to-mentor edges.
Source identities and dates are separately preserved. Source-stated appointments may be historical; this catalog does not assert a complete current roster.
Other advisers named in a CV remain pending if their independent rooted path has not been established.
The one documented shared paper is an observed lower bound, not a complete bibliography. Coauthorship never creates admission or supervision.
Whole CVs/theses are not labeled fully reviewed when only education/title/acknowledgment sections were inspected.
Only already-rooted, explicit mentors admit these persons. No new foundational roots or coauthor-derived mentors.
Original 1,251 assigned fallback cases and 500 frozen extracted documents remain represented by the private inventory; unread records are not complete.
Hsu raw identity is manually corroborated by exact full name, institution and research field; other admissions use independent curated IDs.
This limited source review does not complete every homepage/CV/thesis/lab source for these faculty.
Matheus Ferreira Princeton adviser S. Matthew Weinberg remains pending an independently verified root path. Do not merge him with economics homonym AFT188999.
Adam ONeill also names Ran Canetti and Brent Waters as postdoc hosts; those upstream endpoints lack an admitted identity/path in this batch.

Ralf Haefner names James Binney and Wyn Evans as Oxford DPhil advisers, Matthias Bethge and Steve van Hooser as additional training advisers, and Rick Born as a visiting-fellow sponsor. These remain separately pending root/role evidence.

The Ferreira CV and group page support three current PhD advisees and two graduate/research alumni. Undergraduate-only entries and additional professional research-supervision entries remain separately pending, not automatically typed as PhD.

Ferreira CV and Princeton2022 alumni listing give2022 for the doctorate; Princeton thesis metadata and the adviser roster use2021. That date discrepancy remains unresolved. The registered incoming link is his Harvard postdoc, not a forced choice of doctoral year.
No coauthorship is used to establish mentorship or admit a node.
Document index187 page1 only; no full-CV or full-person completion is claimed.
Gerhard Weikum doctoral and Hussein Suleman masters/undergraduate claims remain in the ledger with unresolved graph integration; no reverse-edge root creation.
Original discovery homepage contains unrelated promotional content; the relationship relies on the archived CV and independent official UCSD/CMU identity corroboration, not that unrelated material.
Web corroboration sources are explicitly not locally archived.
Catalog is frozen pending parent integration; no graph/app/registration edits.
First faculty-explicit-1524-helper.json remains frozen and unmodified.
Relationship statements are locally archived and byte-hash verified; mentor identity web sources are not claimed to be locally archived.
Kaave Hosseini degree year remains unspecified: date 2019 in a combined students/postdocs list is not doctoral graduation evidence.
Getoor doctorate 2001/2002 source discrepancy is recorded rather than silently corrected.
This artifact does not certify full person or department review.
All new people have a directly documented forward mentoring edge from an already admitted person. No new root, reversed ancestry, name-only merge or coauthor admission.

Graduate qualifying-paper and master’s-thesis supervision remain research_mentor edges, explicitly distinct from PhD supervision. Generic certificates, committee membership and group rosters are not imported.
The Stone CV is historical (activities through2012). It does not establish current appointments or a complete current roster. Sources are observed2026-11-18; old scientific dates are retained.
Source-specific curated identities avoid ambiguous raw homonyms. Maria Antoniak alone reuses a separately verified existing AFT identity.
Mimno→Hessel was excluded as a PhD-supervisor claim; Hessel is admitted via explicit Lee doctoral and Choi postdoctoral evidence.
Lillian Lee is an explicit catalog dependency supplied independently by the root agent; the unrelated UC Davis Lillian Lee is not merged.

An integrated person is not a complete review of every mentor, student, or publication. Some coadvisors remain explicitly pending because their identities or upstream paths have not been independently admitted.
Future and expected graduation years are not used as completed degrees. Historical advising institutions are not presented as current employment.
Research areas are assigned only where the person-specific biography, dissertation topic, or roster interest supports them; unlabelled students are not assigned their mentor’s fields.
Hessel and his Lee/Choi relationships are defined in the coordinated part1 catalog; no duplicate person is introduced here.
Undergraduate coauthor lists do not automatically establish individual mentoring.
Lillian Lees thesis explicitly calls Fernando Pereira a mentor, but his verified rooted endpoint remains unresolved; preserved as pending evidence.
Ana Smiths Georgia Tech and KAIST research mentors remain pending endpoint/root reconciliation.
Roster degree years are historical facts. Source retrieval date does not claim the page was updated that day.
Only the single already-rooted researcher is proposed for integration; other named relationships remain in case evidence pending mentor identity or rooted path.
No committee member, committee chair, coauthor, institutional leader or teaching adviser was promoted to a research mentor.
Syracuse live faculty profiles currently contain title-only biography sections. Historical indexed biography is explicitly distinguished from archived live text.
Kennesaw hosts the Oh application CV; this does not establish employment there.
Raw Wolf records remain separate. Andrew Lee chemistry/astrophysics/pharmacy homonyms remain excluded.
No original case is marked a full-career review; nine bounded individual outcomes are recorded without claiming the two URLs are globally complete.
All proposed doctoral edges require an explicit own-source or university adviser statement; lab membership alone is not used.
Use source-specific curated IDs; reject Arizona chemistry Wei Qiu, Houston physics Chris Lin, UT Arlington electrical-engineering Mingyu Lu and UC Riverside physics Xiaojian Chen.
Historical advisor statements, degree years and contemporary job labels are kept distinct. The old current-members heading does not establish current enrollment.
Web-read sources without local bytes are labelled honestly; no shared evidence manifest was modified.
This file is not registered, exported or deployed. It does not alter the frozen third-batch catalog.
Coverage means every pinned authorPub row was checked for the admitted exact AFT IDs; it is not complete real-world publication coverage.
Only score_human == 1 author links contribute. They are human-validated in AFT, not independently audited by this project.
Curated-only people without reviewed exact AFT IDs are unscannable and retain separately documented paper evidence.
Automated and rejected matches are omitted. Existing automated candidate caches cover only their original closure.
Paper counts use AFT pubid, without inferred DOI/title merging. Titles and publication years remain unknown.
Reviewed identity aliases retain raw IDs and source rows; external Semantic Scholar identifiers are not declared equivalent.
This is a descendant candidate universe, NOT a census of all AI researchers. Bulk-only AI relevance remains unassessed.
Root selection includes explicitly named interdisciplinary pioneers. It does not walk up to common ancestors and admit all their descendants.
Unconnected primary-source people are retained in data/overlay-unconnected.json for review, not admitted through coauthorship.
AFT graduate relations do not assert that every person earned a PhD. Current student/postdoc labels are only shown when a dated source supports them.
Automated author matches are archived separately and excluded from the coauthor graph. Human-linked AFT authorship is still source-recorded, not independently audited.
Community editing is a browser-local draft prototype. It does not publish or alter source-backed records.
